# Zaith Al Afkhani

## About
Zaith Al Afkhani is a Kerala-based Ayurvedic brand offering 100% natural, herbal products for hair care and pain relief. Founded in Kovalam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India.

## Products

### Zaith Al Afkhani Hair Oil
A natural Ayurvedic hair oil made from pure herbal ingredients. It nourishes the scalp, strengthens hair from root to tip, reduces hair fall, and promotes healthy hair growth. Free from chemicals and artificial fragrances. Available in 200ml (₹990), 500ml (₹1990), and 1 litre (₹3900) bottles.

### Zaith Al Alam Pain Killer Oil
A natural pain relief oil crafted from Ayurvedic ingredients. It provides fast relief from muscle tension, joint pain, body aches, and everyday discomfort. Safe for all skin types with no side effects. Available in 200ml (₹850) and 500ml (₹1500) bottles.

## Key Features
- 100% natural and organic ingredients
- Trusted Ayurvedic formula
- No internal side effects
- No skin irritation
- No artificial smell or fragrance
- Safe for all skin types
